title: Hike up Stone Mountain with Houston

tellings.quote: yeah yeah and we hiked up Stone Mountain when we were in Atlanta even Dr Powell came with

plain: In 2023, while filming in Atlanta, a film crew hiked up Stone Mountain in Georgia with Houston, a young man who does not speak and who the film says can read minds. Ky Dickens, the filmmaker behind The Telepathy Tapes, a documentary about such children, tells Michels she was there: "we hiked up Stone Mountain when we were in Atlanta even Dr Powell came with," meaning a doctor named Diane Powell, who works with the film.
